This is the line causing the error message

https://github.com/rclone/rclone/blob/bd787e8f457705de9072335fda879f575da4f3cf/cmd/serve/webdav/webdav.go#L392

It must be that this returned nil

https://github.com/rclone/rclone/blob/bd787e8f457705de9072335fda879f575da4f3cf/cmd/serve/webdav/webdav.go#L385

The return from this function is quite allowed to be `nil` if the object hasn't been uploaded yet, which I can see it hasn't in the log above.

This means that the `Content-Type:` is returned as "application/octet-stream" which I guess is causing the problem.

Try this [v1.60.0-beta.6440.f4d822626.fix-6433-webdav-content-type](https://beta.rclone.org/branch/fix-6433-webdav-content-type/v1.60.0-beta.6440.f4d822626.fix-6433-webdav-content-type/) on branch [fix-6433-webdav-content-type](https://github.com/rclone/rclone/tree/fix-6433-webdav-content-type) (uploaded in 15-30 mins)

This will make sure the content-type is always returned as something sensible.
@burner - any update? did the beta work?
wrong burner, I think you meant @burner-

@burner  - so sorry as yes you are correct!

@burner- would the real one please comment :)
